sql.value: select '本年利润' type, ffb.year, ffb.period as month, ffb.end_balance end_balance from fxy_financial_balance ffb left join fxy_financial_subject ffs on ffs.id = ffb.subject_id and ffs.account_sets_id = ffb.account_sets_id where ffs.code = '3103' and ffb.account_sets_id = :accountSetsId and ffb.year = :voucherYear and ffb.auxiliary_detail_id = 0 union select '主营业务收入' type, ffb.year, ffb.period as month, ffb.end_balance end_balance from fxy_financial_balance ffb left join fxy_financial_subject ffs on ffs.id = ffb.subject_id and ffs.account_sets_id = ffb.account_sets_id where ffs.code = '5001' and ffb.account_sets_id = :accountSetsId and ffb.year = :voucherYear and ffb.auxiliary_detail_id = 0

select '销售费用' type, ffb.year, ffb.period as month, ffb.end_balance end_balance from fxy_financial_balance ffb left join fxy_financial_subject ffs on ffs.id = ffb.subject_id and ffs.account_sets_id = ffb.account_sets_id where ffs.code = '5601' and ffb.account_sets_id = :accountSetsId and ffb.year = :voucherYear and ffb.period = :voucherMonth and ffb.auxiliary_detail_id = 0 union select '管理费用' type, ffb.year, ffb.period as month, ffb.end_balance end_balance from fxy_financial_balance ffb left join fxy_financial_subject ffs on ffs.id = ffb.subject_id and ffs.account_sets_id = ffb.account_sets_id where ffs.code = '5602' and ffb.account_sets_id = :accountSetsId and ffb.year = :voucherYear and ffb.period = :voucherMonth and ffb.auxiliary_detail_id = 0 union select '财务费用' type, ffb.year, ffb.period as month, ffb.end_balance end_balance from fxy_financial_balance ffb left join fxy_financial_subject ffs on ffs.id = ffb.subject_id and ffs.account_sets_id = ffb.account_sets_id where ffs.code = '5603' and ffb.account_sets_id = :accountSetsId and ffb.year = :voucherYear and ffb.period = :voucherMonth and ffb.auxiliary_detail_id = 0

select '库存现金' type, ffb.year, ffb.period as month, ffb.end_balance end_balance from fxy_financial_balance ffb left join fxy_financial_subject ffs on ffs.id = ffb.subject_id and ffs.account_sets_id = ffb.account_sets_id where ffs.code = '1001' and ffb.account_sets_id = :accountSetsId and ffb.year = :voucherYear and ffb.period = :voucherMonth and ffb.auxiliary_detail_id = 0 union select '银行存款' type, ffb.year, ffb.period as month, ffb.end_balance end_balance from fxy_financial_balance ffb left join fxy_financial_subject ffs on ffs.id = ffb.subject_id and ffs.account_sets_id = ffb.account_sets_id where ffs.code = '1002' and ffb.account_sets_id = :accountSetsId and ffb.year = :voucherYear and ffb.period = :voucherMonth and ffb.auxiliary_detail_id = 0 union select '其他货币资金' type, ffb.year, ffb.period as month, ffb.end_balance end_balance from fxy_financial_balance ffb left join fxy_financial_subject ffs on ffs.id = ffb.subject_id and ffs.account_sets_id = ffb.account_sets_id where ffs.code = '1012' and ffb.account_sets_id = :accountSetsId and ffb.year = :voucherYear and ffb.period = :voucherMonth and ffb.auxiliary_detail_id = 0

select t.summary from (select trim(summary) summary, count(1) num from fxy_financial_voucher_details where account_sets_id = :accountSetsId and length(trim(summary)) > 0 group by trim(summary)) t order by t.num desc limit 10
SELECT count(ffvd.id) FROM fxy_financial_voucher_details AS ffvd WHERE ffvd.account_sets_id = :accountSetsId and ffvd.auxiliary_detail_id in (:detailIds)

SELECT ffad.id as id FROM fxy_financial_auxiliary_detail AS ffad WHERE ffad.account_sets_id = :accountSetsId #[AND json_contains(ffad.details -> '$[*].categoryType', :categoryType) = 1] #[AND json_contains(ffad.details -> '$[*].categoryId', :categoryId) = 1] #[AND json_contains(ffad.details -> '$[*].value', :detailId) = 1]
